title: GPG — Encryption & Signing
description: Encrypt files, sign commits, and manage GPG keys for secure communications.

entries.label: Generate Key Pair
entries.description: Create a new GPG key pair — choose RSA 4096 and set an expiration

entries.label: List Keys
entries.description: Show all public keys in your keyring with short key IDs

entries.label: Export Public Key
entries.description: Export your public key in ASCII format for sharing

entries.label: Encrypt File
entries.description: Encrypt a file so only the recipient can decrypt it

entries.label: Decrypt File
entries.description: Decrypt a file using your private key

entries.label: Sign a File
entries.description: Create a detached signature to verify file authenticity

entries.label: Git Commit Signing
entries.command:
git config --global user.signingkey <KEY_ID>
git config --global commit.gpgsign true
entries.description: Configure git to sign all commits with your GPG key

entries.label: Symmetric Encrypt
entries.description: Encrypt with a passphrase (no key pair needed) — recipient uses same passphrase
